tokenNonce.description: The nonce used in the HTTP header to authenticate the request.

remoteAddress.description: The IP address of the request's emiter.

requestMethod.description: The HTTP method of the request

uriRequested.description: The Universal Resource Identifier given for this request.

parametersGiven.description: The optional parameters *(e.g. after the ?)* given for this request.

responseBody.description: The text sent by the server as a result for the request.

restErrorTypeId.description: If there is an error during the processing the request, this id could be used to find this error.

login.description: The login used for the request.

legalname.description: The legal name of the client used for the request.

Datetime.description: A String representing a date by its year, month, day in month, hour, minute and second.

ID.description: A String representing the id of an object. This string contains alpha-numeric characters, including the capital ones.
